set.body:
Current plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md, Full event-graph delivery. Owner approved proceeding 2026-11-16.

Scope: Reuse NMP phases 1-3 and the existing acquisition/record-replay seam. Resolve the detail/graph vocabulary ADR and proposed NMP profile before new public types land; the owner decides those ADRs. Classify each required field as existing, checked composition, semantic gap or refused. Keep producer assertions separate from authority. F0 alternative A remains settled: generated captions cannot license film SurfaceExplicit.

Engineering acceptance artifact: One admitted synthetic proposal packet replayed through the public resolver, with accepted and refused record receipts; forged authority, changed input identity and unsupported semantic fields are refused by named controls. Pin field inventory, model/recipe/request and response identities. This is engineering readiness, not scientific truth or model accuracy.

Scope is one bounded synthetic account and its public path, not a whole-corpus extraction. Use repository reference-scope gates, relevant mutation/compile-refusal evidence and exact-SHA cold review. Graph-wide integration and fresh-data qualification remain on the existing E0 and human-evaluation tickets. Claim this slice, not a parent container.
set.title: [event-graph] Freeze the bounded producer profile and prove replay admission
